name: Adelaite Diondale
original_name: アデライト・ディオンデール
source:
One of the Knight Captains of the Kingdom of Fordgilia, a popular person who is admired by both colleagues and the people of Fordgilia. Adelite has a masculine personality because she wanted to be born as man. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ202395.html]DLSite[/url]]
